'''''Liberating the Blackguard''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] in a basic blueprint style with various angles of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The painting's title refers to the [[Retaking of the Blackguard|liberation]] of the ''Blackguard'' from its mutinous [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Andal Sait]], by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Liberating The Blackguard'' is a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multi-player online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The player could receive it as a reward for completing the "DePalma's Dispatch" collection which required the player to pilot and land their own ship onto the ''Blackguard'' a total of twenty-five times. The player could only receive credit for landing on the ''Blackguard'' every six hours. The painting and collection were added to the game on [[January 15]], [[2008]] as part of the ''Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis'' game update. The player could use the painting in one of their personal buildings as decoration.<ref name="SWG" />
